design.selection: highest semantic version among published versioned releases, including previews; drafts, unversioned tester tags and missing publish dates excluded
design.schedule: desktop startup and hourly wakeups; successful results reused for 24 hours; failures backed off for one hour; manual checks bypass local throttling
design.ui: quiet existing Notifications bell, Help check, General preference; browser opens the fixed Public GitHub release page
design.installation: user reviews release notes/downloads; no binary download or installer is run
